TIFF scalar volume fixtures
===========================

seq-1c-8b-multipage-adeefdcc.tiff is retained unchanged from image-rs/image-tiff
at commit 3302936b08e2260d4c66f40f51170efbb1fded4c:
https://github.com/image-rs/image-tiff/blob/3302936b08e2260d4c66f40f51170efbb1fded4c/tests/images/seq/seq-1c-8b-multipage-adeefdcc.tiff

SHA-256: f9dd5eb92e193f121b2afcb3575d2be5566adb6198afcb5009516a77972d6428
Size: 1,262 bytes.
License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2018 PistonDevelopers.
The original 1,073-byte notice is retained unchanged as IMAGE-TIFF-LICENSE.

The upstream tests/gen_seq_tiff.c producer uses libtiff to write three actual
16x16 uint8 pages. All pages have NewSubfileType=2 and PageNumber metadata.
Every source sample equals (16*y+x+50*z)%256. Independent tests verify the
original bytes, source-addressed strips, 384 occupied voxels, 1,208 outward
triangles, surface area 604 and closed volume 384.

The other inputs are authored by this project, under its MIT license, and are
regenerated by examples/fixtures/tiff_volumes.rs. They qualify an asymmetric
voxel solid, classic and BigTIFF directories, both byte orders, signed integer
and floating samples, WhiteIsZero, rational physical spacing and Deflate
compression. These authored controls do not claim compatibility with every
TIFF producer or multidimensional scientific container. The original image
above provides a separate external producer witness.

Single-page TIFF remains a fitted raster image. Homogeneous scalar page stacks
use the shared bounded density surface. RGB stacks, heterogeneous image series,
unaddressed ImageJ planes and OME hyperstack axes are outside this subset.
